name: CreateZipArchive
caption: Create ZIP archive

configuration.description: File name of the archive. SmartText, e.g. 'Invoices {{workdate}}.zip'. '.zip' is appended when missing, ':' becomes '_'. Empty = archive.zip.

Rows of { type, reference, content, fileName }, packed in order. Required in practice: without rows there is nothing to pack, which fails the step while errorIfEmpty is true. Rows can carry extra editor keys (lineNo); they are ignored.

document = AutoFlow document records (table 5564415) from reference; attachment = Incoming Document Attachment records (table 133) from reference; base64 = content decoded from base64. Matched case-insensitively; any other value fails the step at runtime.

document / attachment rows: exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to a reference, an array or an iterator, read in its raw form. Each record it holds becomes one entry. A reference that resolves to nothing adds nothing, without an error.
base64 rows: base64 text (SmartText). If the raw value is exactly one SmartField holding binary data (an HTTP Request responseBody, a BLOB field), the bytes are taken as they are.

Entry path inside the archive (SmartText). Optional for document/attachment rows (default: the record's own name - document name, or attachment Name.File Extension), required for base64 rows. May contain folders (invoices/2026/INV-1001.pdf, '\' counts as '/'); a value ending in '/' is a folder only and each record keeps its own name. '..', '.', a leading '/' and a drive prefix are dropped, ':' becomes '_'. On a row whose reference holds several records, SmartFields starting with the row's reference are resolved per record.
true: no file to pack fails the step. false: no archive is created, created = "false" and the flow continues.

outputs.name: created
outputs.when: always - "true" when an archive was created, "false" when nothing was packed and errorIfEmpty is false

outputs.name: Document
outputs.when: when created - the archive in the AutoFlow document library (table 5564415 mse365 AF Document, content type application/zip)

outputs.name: name
outputs.when: when created - the archive's file name

outputs.name: size
outputs.when: when created - the archive's size in bytes

outputs.name: fileCount
outputs.when: always - number of entries; "0" when nothing was packed

rules.check: No row yielded an entry (files empty, references resolved to nothing) while errorIfEmpty is true (the default).
rules.message: There are no files to put into the archive. Check the Files list - a SmartField there may not have resolved, or an earlier step found no records. Turn off "Error if empty" to continue without an archive.

rules.check: files[].type is not document, attachment or base64 (case-insensitive). %1 = 1-based row number.
A document/attachment row's reference resolves to values only, no records.
rules.message: The reference %1 must point at a record, not at a value.

rules.check: A referenced record is not of table 5564415 (document rows) or 133 (attachment rows).
rules.message: The reference %1 must point at a record of the table %2; it points at table %3.

rules.check: A referenced record no longer exists.
rules.message: The record %1 referenced by %2 no longer exists.

rules.check: An incoming document attachment has no content.
rules.message: The incoming document attachment %1 has no content.

rules.check: A base64 row's resolved fileName is empty. %1 = 1-based row number.
rules.message: File %1: a base64 file needs a file name, e.g. data.xml.

rules.check: A base64 row's resolved content is empty (and it is not a binary SmartField).
rules.message: The content of %1 is empty. A SmartField there may not have resolved.

rules.check: A base64 row's resolved content is not valid base64.
rules.message: The content of %1 is not valid base64.

notes: The editor has no required fields and there is no publish-time check. The step's own design-time messages ('Add at least one file to the archive.', 'File %1: choose the reference whose file is put into the archive.', 'File %1: the reference "%2" must use the SmartField notation, e.g. {{pdf_Document}}.', 'File %1: enter the base64 content.') are not run: an empty or misspelled reference adds nothing.
Entries with the same path (case-insensitive) are numbered: invoice.pdf, invoice (2).pdf, invoice (3).pdf. A '/' or '\' inside a record's own name becomes '_' (record data never creates folders).
Every archive is a new AutoFlow document; delete it with Delete Record on {{slug_Document}} when it is not needed afterwards. The archive is built in memory.
With errorIfEmpty false, check {{slug_created}} (e.g. with a Decision) before using {{slug_Document}}.
